name: Zebra

criteria: Both original mesh sources remain unchanged. The two freight keels, two actual cross-bridges, cockpit, drive structures and source-local well regions retain separate support ownership.
Each original triangle remains enclosed by its own declared support; no broad central convex fill. The real centre freight trench remains open over the full 40m translation.

The packaged original 744-face native source exceeds its 512 cap. Its separate frozen 20-part reduction source proposal is explicitly unexecuted and uninstalled. This port does not select, execute or qualify it.

engineering.scope: Original adopted source budget and full signed inertia retained; actual material construction, loaded mass, hardware/crew/paid role rights unresolved.

sourceOnly.scope: Pinned source and actual fixed Git blob command with strictly resolved repository cwd; spaced path/missing input regression; immutable source, engineering bits, visual and shape replay.

acceptance: Five actual controlled World routes and inclusive 34-unit speed boundary; typed SH008/SH010 source and scope cross-refusal remains intact.
Ordinary Showroom retains original ice-blue geometry; no SH020 Crow alias or ordinary exchange; full central trench and twin keels visibly distinguish SH021.

metal.invocation: Set each variable to a distinct new absolute directory and run cargo test --locked -p meridian-desktop <test> -- --ignored --exact --nocapture.
metal.scope: Production offscreen direct original RGB and full-target pane union in both Explorer/Zebra and Custom/Zebra orders; three distinct solo cache returns. Minimum 640×360 logical. Native resize/compositor and GPU timing separate.

remaining: Owned Rust, native Metal and exact native source/collision qualification.
Ordinary placement, acquisition, paid equipment, loaded engineering and crew custody.
SH020 Crow Prototype remains separately owned; no implementation or source imports here.
